item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":0,"rationale":"The President supplies policy findings and explanatory background concerning WTO developing-country treatment, but this segment neither directs an agency action nor itself changes legal rights or status.","evidence":"The WTO is in desperate need of reform"},{"segment_id":"2","code":2,"rationale":"The USTR is conditionally required, after a 90-day assessment and specified consultations, to impose a later consequential treatment decision by no longer treating certain WTO Members as developing countries; the accompanying negotiation, reporting, consultation, and publication duties do not displace that dictated outcome.","evidence":"no longer treat as a developing country for the purposes of the WTO any WTO Member that in the USTR's judgment is improperly declaring itself a developing country"},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"The President directs the USTR to perform the ministerial publication of the memorandum in the Federal Register, an executive housekeeping action with no substantive legal consequence specified here.","evidence":"authorized and directed to publish this memorandum in the Federal Register"}]}
